rationale: Positives: The agent authenticated the user via email, verified orders belonged to the same user, checked order and product details before changes, correctly performed the item swap after explicitly confirming the new variant and price difference, and cancellation was eligible based on status. Issues: The agent executed two order-changing writes without explicit confirmation: (1) updated the shipping address on #W5056519 to match #W8277957 immediately after retrieving the reference order, without first stating the exact new address and asking the user to confirm; (2) canceled #W5995614 without first confirming the cancellation action and refund details. Both violate the policy requirement to obtain explicit confirmation prior to any order-changing action. Minor: The stated refund timeframe (5–7 business days) is not supported by the tool output. Due to these confirmation lapses, the conversation fails the pass bar.
